1-2: AGE COMPLEXITY (1-2 years / toddler): Use extra-bold thick outlines, very large simple closed shapes, minimal background elements and generous open white space suited for fat crayons.
3-4: AGE COMPLEXITY (3-4 years / preschool): Use bold clear outlines, large friendly coloring regions, balanced simple background shapes and uncluttered spacing.
5-7: AGE COMPLEXITY (5-7 years / early school): Use medium-clean outlines, rich playful background details and well-defined coloring regions suitable for colored pencils or markers.
8+: AGE COMPLEXITY (8+ years / older kids): Use crisp medium-fine outlines with intricate background details, expressive patterns and varied coloring areas.
